Prakash Kumar Saw vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ... Opp. Party

Author: Anubha Rawat Choudhary
Bench: Anubha Rawat Choudhary
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 Cr. Revision No. 163 of 2024
Prakash Kumar Saw, aged about 17 years, son of Prameshwar Saw, resident of
village Badasingha Belkapi, P.O. & P.S. Gorhar, District Hazaribagh,
represented through his father and natural guardian Prameshwar Saw aged
about 38 years, S/o Baleshwar Saw, resident of village Badasingha Belkapi,
P.O. & P.S. Goarhar, District Hazaribagh ... ... Petitioner

1.

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

2.  This criminal revision application is directed against the order of dismissal dated 19.01.2024 passed by the learned Special Judge-1-cum- Children Court, Hazaribagh in Cr. Appeal (Juvenile)
No. 1 of 2024 against the order refusing bail to the petitioner by the learned Principal Magistrate,
Juvenile Justice Board, Hazaribagh in connection with Gorhar P.S. Case No. 39/2023 registered under Sections 420/385/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 66C/67 of the Information Technology (Amendment) Act vide order dated 19.12.2023.
3.
The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is in Class-XII and wants to pursue his studies.

He has further submitted that the father of the petitioner is present in the court and has undertaken to ensure that the petitioner continues his study and does not come in connection with anti- social aliments.

He has also submitted that the petitioner may be released on bail and the Probation Officer of the District can be directed to submit social investigation report of the petitioner at regular interval so that the activity of the petitioner stands monitor by the Court.
Prakash Kumar Saw vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...

1 4.

The learned counsel for the petitioner has also submitted that co-accused, namely, Sanjay Kumar Saw @ Sanjay Kumar has been enlarged on bail by virtue of order dated 14.05.2024 passed in Cr.
Revision No. 178 of 2024.

5. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State though has opposed the prayer of the petitioner but has submitted that if the father of the petitioner takes appropriate care, then the petitioner can be released on bail.
The probation officer of the concerned district by directed to submit social investigation report of the petitioner at regular intervals.

6. After hearing the learned counsel for the parties and considering the facts and circumstances of this case particularly the fact that the petitioner is a student of Class-XII as submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner, this Court is of the considered view that it is in the interest of the petitioner that he continues with his studies and ultimately gets assimilated with the mainstream of the society.
In view of the undertaking given by the learned counsel for the petitioner under the instructions of the father of the petitioner, the petitioner has undertaken to continue his studies.

7. Accordingly, the impugned orders are hereby set-aside and the petitioner is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rs. Twenty-Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Principal Magistrate, Juvenile Justice Board, Hazaribagh in connection with Gorhar P.S. Case No. 39 of 2023 subject to the following conditions: -
(i) One of the bailors would be his father and the other would be a close relative.
(ii) The father of the petitioner would ensure that the petitioner continues his studies and attends the educational institutions regularly and take appropriate care so that the petitioner does not come in contact with anti-social elements.

(iii) The Probation Officer of the concerned district shall submit a social investigation report every three months from today with particular reference to as to whether the petitioner is undertaking his studies or not.
The report be furnished before the learned Juvenile Justice Board, Hazaribagh from time to time.
8. This criminal revision application is accordingly disposed of.

9. Let a copy of this order be communicated to the court concerned through 'e-mail/FAX'.
(Anubha Rawat Choudhary, J.) Mukul Prakash Kumar Saw vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ... Opp. Party on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91489891/
